module: Flowgraph node "Apply Penalty" (category impulse, crawl). Manually applies penalty points to the active crawl, choosing a type from the bridge list (gameplay/crawl/flowgraphBridge). Input pins: flow (pulse) and penaltyType (string).
notes: work writes self.pinOut.success and failed, but pinSchema declares no output pin: these accesses crash if penaltyType is empty.
If penaltyType is valid, the result of bridge.applyPenalty is not exposed.

postInit.desc: Fills the templates of the penaltyType pin with bridge.getPenaltyTypes().

work.desc: Calls bridge.applyPenalty(penaltyType) if the type is set.
